Name: Tapper Crop
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone, this mod add 7 crops that produce the items that you can get from the Tapper: Oak Resin, Maple Syrup, Pine Tar, Sap, Common Mushroom, Purple Mushroom and Red Mushroom.
You can buy the seeds from Pierre.
This crops can grow in every season, the mushrooms seeds (Common, Red and Purple) take 15 days to mature, and keep produce 7 mushroom every 5 days, the tree seeds (Oak, Maple, Pine and Mahogany) need 20 days to mature and keep produce 7 Oak Resin/Maple Syrup/Pine Tar every 7 days, or 28 sap for the Mahogany "Tree" (The tree is actually only a trunk).
You can make the seeds if you put Sap/Pine Tar/Oak Resin/Maple Syrup/Red Mushroom/Purple Mushrooms into a Seed Maker (Common Mushroom will make Fall Seeds: it's a vanilla's feature)
The tree crops are the same as trellis crops: you cannot walk trough them.
This mod was created for personal use, but I see no reason not to share it with the Stardew's community.

[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
